claim_boundary: SQ-03D measures context dependence inside the frozen MoscaQuant matched central-brain model. A nonzero reciprocity residual means that the same male/female edge-weight difference has different modeled consequences when embedded in the two matched network backgrounds. It does not establish a biological sex mechanism, organism-level behavior, population-level statistical significance, intelligence differences, or financial utility.
title: THE SAME KNIFE CUTS DIFFERENTLY
